issues: 浅灰底 + 1px 黑细线 + S1–S4 小白圆，像一张流程图示意，没有光也没有产品感
四个节点同时到达汇聚点，吞并只有一次小脉冲，全片缺一个节奏高点
节点缩小到消失时仍是白圆片，读不出「被吸进去 / 化成数据」
结尾徽标停在画面右侧，13px 字幕「Four sources unified」在 1080p 下几乎读不出
changes: look 换成 aurora 极光暗场：来源做成 128px 深色玻璃砖 + 线性图标，配 40px 名称与 mono 规模注记；汇聚点是 168px 极光渐变徽标 + 两圈慢转细环 + 大面积泛光
光路改为 10px 柔光底 + 2.4px 暗紫→亮粉渐变线，5f 错峰 draw-on；数据包是带 12 段彗尾的白色亮点，两个整数周期
四路按 5f 错峰汇入（到达 108/113/118/123f），徽标被连打四下、每下更亮，外圈四段弧逐段点亮、右上「N / 4 SYNCED」同步——da-da-da-DUM
节点沿真实曲线三段式缩小（128→44→0），中段被强调色点燃并收成光球，名称同时向左退场退焦
收尾：光路从起点反向擦除，相机平移 480px + 推近 1.1 把徽标收到正中，末次吸入一圈涟漪，96px 结论句「One source of truth.」逐词升起，hold 22f
issuesEn: A light grey ground with 1px black hairlines and small white S1–S4 discs read like a flowchart sketch, with no light and no product feel
All four nodes reached the hub at once, so the merge was a single small pulse and the shot lacked a rhythmic peak
The nodes were still white discs as they shrank away, so they never read as being sucked in or turned into data
The final badge sat off to the right, and the 13px caption 'Four sources unified' was barely legible at 1080p
changesEn: Switched to the aurora look: sources are 128px dark glass tiles with line icons, each with a 40px name and a mono scale note; the hub is a 168px aurora-gradient badge with two slowly counter-rotating rings and a wide bloom
Paths are now a 10px soft glow under a 2.4px violet-to-pink gradient line, drawn on with a 5f stagger; packets are bright white dots with 12-segment comet tails over two whole cycles

The four routes arrive on a 5f stagger (108/113/118/123f), so the badge takes four hits, each brighter than the last, while its outer four-segment arc and the 'N / 4 SYNCED' counter fill in step: da-da-da-DUM
Nodes shrink in three phases along the real curves (128→44→0), ignite with the accent light mid-way and round into orbs, while their names exit left with a defocus

Ending: paths erase back from their origins, the camera pans 480px and pushes to 1.1 to centre the badge, the last absorption sends out a ripple, and a 96px 'One source of truth.' rises word by word before a 22f hold
